subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: Which treaty, signed in 1919, formally ended World War I between the Allies and Germany?
choices: Treaty of Tordesillas
Treaty of Versailles
Treaty of Westphalia
Treaty of Nanjing
explanation: The Treaty of Versailles was signed in June 1919. It required Germany to accept responsibility for the war, pay reparations, give up territory and limit its military.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: Germany's invasion of which country in September 1939 began World War II in Europe?
choices: France
Belgium
Norway
Poland
explanation: Germany invaded Poland on September 1, 1939. Britain and France declared war on Germany two days later.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: The leader of India's nonviolent independence movement against British rule was Mohandas ___.
explanation: Mohandas (Mahatma) Gandhi led campaigns of nonviolent resistance such as the Salt March of 1930. India became independent in 1947.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: The Cold War was mainly a rivalry between which two superpowers?
choices: The United States and the Soviet Union
Germany and Japan
Britain and France
China and India
correctAnswer: The United States and the Soviet Union
explanation: From the late 1940s until about 1991, the United States and the Soviet Union competed for global influence without fighting each other directly.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: Which international organization was founded in 1945 to promote peace and cooperation among nations?
choices: The League of Nations
NATO
The United Nations
The European Union
explanation: The United Nations was founded in 1945, at the end of World War II, replacing the League of Nations.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: Which is a defining feature of a totalitarian state?
choices: Power is shared among several competing parties chosen in free elections
One party controls the government and tries to control nearly all of life
The press is free to criticize the leaders and their policies openly
Courts are independent and can overrule the ruler's decisions
correctAnswer: One party controls the government and tries to control nearly all of life
explanation: Totalitarian regimes, such as Nazi Germany and the Soviet Union under Stalin, used a single party, propaganda, censorship and terror to control society.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: The Marshall Plan, begun in 1948, was designed to do what?
choices: Punish Germany with reparations
Create a military alliance of communist states in Eastern Europe
Help rebuild the economies of Western Europe after World War II
Divide Korea into two countries at the 38th parallel after the war
correctAnswer: Help rebuild the economies of Western Europe after World War II
explanation: The Marshall Plan provided American economic aid to rebuild Western Europe. It was also intended to reduce the appeal of communism.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: Which of the following were events of the Cold War? Select all that apply.
choices: The Berlin Airlift
The Cuban Missile Crisis
The Korean War
The Congress of Vienna
The Boxer Rebellion
explanation: The Berlin Airlift (1948-1949), the Korean War (1950-1953) and the Cuban Missile Crisis (1962) were Cold War confrontations. The Congress of Vienna (1814-1815) and the Boxer Rebellion (1899-1901) came earlier.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: Use the word bank: apartheid, Mandela, 1994. South Africa's system of legal racial segregation was called ___. Nelson ___ spent 27 years in prison for opposing it. He was elected president in the country's first fully democratic election in ___.
explanation: Apartheid was in force in South Africa from 1948 until the early 1990s. Nelson Mandela was released in 1990 after 27 years in prison and was elected president in 1994.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: The Universal Declaration of Human Rights (1948) was adopted largely in response to what?
choices: The atrocities of World War II, including the Holocaust
The collapse of the Soviet Union and the end of the Cold War
The Industrial Revolution
The Berlin Conference
correctAnswer: The atrocities of World War II, including the Holocaust
explanation: After the Holocaust and other atrocities of World War II, the United Nations adopted the declaration in 1948 to state the rights to which all people are entitled.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: Which event in 1989 became a symbol of the end of communist rule in Eastern Europe?
choices: The Cuban Missile Crisis
The Suez Crisis
The partition of India
The fall of the Berlin Wall
correctAnswer: The fall of the Berlin Wall
explanation: The Berlin Wall, which had divided the city since 1961, was opened in November 1989. Germany reunified in 1990 and the Soviet Union dissolved in 1991.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: Which is the best example of economic globalization?
choices: A village that grows all of its own food and trades with no outsiders at all
A phone designed in one country, assembled in another from foreign parts
A country that bans all imports to protect its own factories
A government that prints its own money for use inside its borders
correctAnswer: A phone designed in one country, assembled in another from foreign parts
explanation: Globalization is the growing integration of economies through trade, investment, technology and supply chains that cross many borders.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: A historian argues that the Treaty of Versailles was more responsible than the Great Depression for the rise of dictatorship in Germany. Which piece of evidence would most effectively challenge this interpretation?
choices: Germany suffered severe hyperinflation in 1923, during the crisis over paying war reparations
The Treaty of Versailles required Germany to accept responsibility for World War I
Nazi support was tiny in the prosperous late 1920s and surged only after the Depression began
Many Germans bitterly resented the land and colonies that the treaty took away from Germany
correctAnswer: Nazi support was tiny in the prosperous late 1920s and surged only after the Depression began
explanation: The Nazi Party won under 3 percent of the vote in 1928 but over 37 percent in July 1932, after mass unemployment set in. This timing suggests the Depression, not the treaty alone, was decisive. The other options support the historian's claim.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: Arrange these events in chronological order from earliest to latest.
orderedItems: The Treaty of Versailles is signed
World War II begins in Europe
explanation: The Treaty of Versailles was signed in 1919, World War II began in 1939, India became independent in 1947, the Cuban Missile Crisis occurred in 1962, the Berlin Wall fell in 1989 and the Soviet Union dissolved in 1991.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: This statement announced which Cold War policy?
passage: "I believe that it must be the policy of the United States to support free peoples who are resisting attempted subjugation by armed minorities or by outside pressures." - President Harry S. Truman, address to the United States Congress, March 12, 1947
choices: Appeasement of aggressors
Isolation from world affairs
Détente with the Soviet Union
Containment of the spread of communism
correctAnswer: Containment of the spread of communism
explanation: The speech, known as the Truman Doctrine, committed the United States to aiding countries threatened by communist movements or Soviet pressure, the policy called containment.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: Which of the following was a long-term cause, rather than a triggering event, of World War II in Europe?
choices: Resentment in Germany over the terms of the Treaty of Versailles
Germany's invasion of Poland on September 1, 1939, with tanks and aircraft
Britain and France's declaration of war on Germany in September 1939
The German attack on France in 1940
correctAnswer: Resentment in Germany over the terms of the Treaty of Versailles
explanation: Long-term causes build up over years; triggering events set off the conflict. Resentment of the Versailles settlement grew for two decades, whereas the invasion of Poland was the trigger and the other events followed it.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: Which statement best compares the independence movements in India and Algeria?
choices: Both gained independence through votes of the United Nations
India relied mostly on nonviolent protest; Algeria fought a long war against France
Both were colonies of Belgium
India fought an eight-year war against Britain, while Algeria relied only on boycotts
correctAnswer: India relied mostly on nonviolent protest; Algeria fought a long war against France
explanation: India's independence movement, led by Gandhi and the Indian National Congress, relied largely on nonviolent resistance and negotiation (1947). Algeria became independent in 1962 after an eight-year war against France.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: A historian is studying how ordinary Soviet citizens experienced the 1930s. Why should a 1935 government poster showing cheerful collective farmers be used with caution?
choices: It was produced too long ago to tell us anything useful about the 1930s
Posters are artwork, so they can never be used as historical evidence
It was made by the state to show how the government wanted life to look
It was made by a foreign government
correctAnswer: It was made by the state to show how the government wanted life to look
explanation: A propaganda poster is good evidence of the message a government wanted to send, but its purpose makes it unreliable as a description of daily life. It should be compared with other sources such as letters, diaries and statistics.
